scenario: Occupied office becomes too warm
detection_logic: Occupied AND temperature outside approved band for 5 min; clear within inner band for 5 min
data_analysis: Occupied comfort minutes / valid occupied minutes; compare matched schedule
agent_action: Comfort Agent recommends OEM setpoint change; operator approves
outcome_measure: Valid occupied minutes within band / valid occupied minutes
limitation: Minutes of service quality; no promised savings
test_case: Replay excursion, unoccupied period and recovery

scenario: AC consumes more while cooling less
detection_logic: Cooling active 10 min AND delta-T below commissioned lower limit AND power above matched baseline for 15 min
data_analysis: Delta-T and load trend by mode, outdoor context and occupancy; no COP/RUL claim
agent_action: Maintenance Agent creates inspection work order
outcome_measure: Inspection acknowledged_at minus event_at
limitation: No standard COP, OEE or RUL claim
test_case: Inject degraded delta-T and invalid probe; invalid probe yields Unknown

scenario: Empty zone continues cooling
detection_logic: Verified unoccupied 20 min AND cooling power above idle threshold
data_analysis: Avoidable runtime and kWh against approved occupancy schedule
agent_action: Comfort Agent proposes setback; operator approves within bounds
outcome: Reduced unattended runtime while honoring comfort
outcome_measure: Minutes cooling during verified vacancy
test_case: False vacancy and manual override prevent action

scenario: Office air becomes stuffy
detection_logic: Verified real CO2 or PM channel exceeds site-approved limit for 5 min
data_analysis: Exposure duration and occupied-time burden; eCO2 labeled separately
agent_action: IAQ Agent advises ventilation and checks response; no health diagnosis
outcome_measure: Occupied minutes above approved limits
limitation: Not a medical or smoke-detection system
test_case: Replay threshold, sensor warm-up and unavailable channel

scenario: Pump runs but tank does not fill
use_case: Suspected dry run or blocked delivery
detection_logic: Pump active 60 s AND low flow AND no destination rise for 120 s; require commissioned hydraulic delay
data_analysis: Flow / kWh, fill slope and source-level context; classify as suspected
twin_relationship: Pump draws from Source and fills Tank
agent_action: Water Agent alerts operator; local interlock alone handles protective stop
outcome_measure: Pump-on minutes with corroborated low flow/no fill
test_case: Local low-level trip works offline; missing flow blocks diagnosis

scenario: Terrace tank nears overflow
detection_logic: Level above approved high limit 20 s OR independent high float asserted
data_analysis: Time to high limit only when recent fill slope is valid; geometry calibrated
agent_action: Water Agent recommends stop; local high float has priority
outcome: Less overflow and preserved water availability
outcome_measure: Local stop_at minus independent high_float_at
test_case: High-float test with broker offline; no cloud bypass

scenario: Water level falls unexpectedly overnight
detection_logic: No planned demand AND negative water balance above commissioned tolerance for 15 min
data_analysis: Inflow minus outflow minus storage change; flag unmetered demand
agent_action: Water Agent asks operator to inspect; no definitive leak claim from level alone
outcome_measure: Inflow L - outflow L - storage increase L
test_case: Replay legitimate demand and sensor drift to suppress false alarm

scenario: RO produces less treated water per feed
detection_logic: Positive matched feed volume AND recovery below validated baseline for 3 complete cycles
data_analysis: Product/feed volume; L/kWh; pressure trend; reset-aware deltas
twin_relationship: RO includes Pumps and Product Tank
agent_action: Maintenance Agent opens RO inspection task; existing controller retains control
outcome: Improved recovery visibility and service continuity
outcome_measure: Matched product L / feed L; product L / pump kWh
test_case: Zero feed, mismatched intervals and counter reset yield unavailable recovery

scenario: Sump cannot supply next pump cycle
detection_logic: Source level below commissioned reserve for 60 s
data_analysis: Reserve hours only with valid demand and geometry; no invented volume
agent_action: Water Agent advises refill; source-low interlock retained
outcome_measure: Source reserve L / valid consumption L per hour
test_case: Low reserve and absent demand history produce appropriate advisory

scenario: Server room warms or PSU reports fault
detection_logic: Vendor reported fault immediately OR inlet temperature above approved vendor limit for 2 polls
data_analysis: Correlate iLO event, room temperature and fan trend; rack energy distinct
twin_relationship: Server located in Space powered by UPS
agent_action: Infrastructure Agent escalates to administrator; no autonomous mains cutoff
outcome_measure: Administrator acknowledged_at - fault_at
test_case: Replay PSU fault, failed poll and room heating; inspect smoke-event equipment first

scenario: UPS battery data becomes abnormal
detection_logic: BMS alarm immediately OR verified temperature/voltage outside OEM bounds for 2 polls
data_analysis: Measured SoC only if supported; voltage is not substituted for SoC
twin_relationship: UPS supports Server; Battery connected to verified system
agent_action: Infrastructure Agent alerts administrator and records vendor evidence
outcome_measure: Valid supported battery metrics / required supported metrics
test_case: Unavailable SoC remains null; separate solar/battery topology verified

scenario: Connectivity disappears
detection_logic: Three missed commissioned heartbeat periods; distinguish broker loss from node loss
data_analysis: Availability by failure domain; correlate gateway and broker state
agent_action: Reliability Agent routes incident to infrastructure owner
outcome_measure: Reachable minutes / eligible observation minutes
limitation: Connectivity is distinct from equipment health
test_case: Disconnect node then gateway; affected twins become Unknown

scenario: Domestic and commercial accounts need separate reporting
detection_logic: Account counter reset or branch sum exceeds incomer beyond approved tolerance
data_analysis: Separate account totals; branch sums diagnostic only; no parent-child double count
agent_action: Energy Agent flags balance mismatch; owner validates boundary
outcome_measure: Incomer kWh - directly comparable branch sum kWh
test_case: Replay nested meter data and reset; never sum parent plus children

scenario: Solar yield falls against relevant conditions
detection_logic: Inverter fault OR yield below matched weather/context baseline across 3 valid days
data_analysis: Generation/export by same interval; no irradiance-free guaranteed performance ratio
agent_action: Energy Agent recommends inspection; read-only inverter integration
outcome_measure: PV generation kWh and export kWh by interval
test_case: Missing weather yields limited comparison; no implied battery integration

scenario: Owner wants evidence-based emissions reporting
detection_logic: Block calculation if factor geography/year/method or baseline approval missing
data_analysis: Scope 2 = purchased kWh x approved factor; avoided estimate kept separate
agent_action: ESG Agent assembles evidence for second-person verification
outcome_measure: Purchased kWh x approved kgCO2e/kWh factor
test_case: Missing factor, baseline and overlapping boundaries block qualification

scenario: Lights or fans remain on after occupancy ends
detection_logic: Verified unoccupied 20 min AND branch load exceeds approved idle profile
data_analysis: Circuit runtime and kWh; no individual fault inference from aggregate
agent_action: Schedule Agent advises or requests rated approved local control
outcome_measure: Minutes branch load exceeds idle during validated vacancy
limitation: No appliance attribution from shared circuit
test_case: Mixed circuit and emergency lighting exclusions verified

scenario: Panel inventory is mistaken for independently metered assets
detection_logic: Reject independent energy claim for unmetered registry object
data_analysis: Coverage by measured circuit and physical instance, not one sensor per object
twin_relationship: Board and Outlet contained in Circuit; furniture registry only
agent_action: Registry Agent flags unbound object for installer
outcome_measure: Bound physical instances / surveyed eligible instances
proposed_acceptance: All commissioned instances bound or explicitly excluded
limitation: Furniture and outlet count is not sensor count
test_case: Work table has no fabricated kWh; outlets inherit context without duplicated totals

scenario: Refrigerator temperature rises persistently
detection_logic: Temperature outside appliance-approved band beyond approved door/defrost allowance
data_analysis: Excursion minutes, compressor runtime if separately measured; no food safety certification
agent_action: Appliance Agent alerts pantry operator; no autonomous cutoff
outcome_measure: Valid minutes beyond approved temperature band
test_case: Replay defrost, door open and sensor disconnect

scenario: Kitchen appliance branch draws unusual power
detection_logic: Branch power exceeds commissioned circuit threshold for 5 min
data_analysis: Schedule-matched circuit load; individual attribution only with direct channel
agent_action: Appliance Agent requests operator inspection; mains protection independent
outcome_measure: Reset-aware cumulative kWh delta
proposed_acceptance: Daily energy available with quality labels
limitation: Separate submeter required for individual attribution
test_case: Concurrent appliances do not generate unsupported individual diagnosis

scenario: Geyser heats outside needed hours
detection_logic: Heating outside approved schedule for 10 min OR runtime exceeds validated cycle
data_analysis: Heating kWh, runtime and service-temperature context
agent_action: Hot Water Agent proposes timer; approved rated contactor with thermostat/cutout retained
outcome: Reduced unnecessary heating with service maintained
outcome_measure: Heating minutes within schedule / valid heating minutes
proposed_acceptance: Maintain service while reducing outside-hours heating
test_case: Manual override, thermal cutout and contactor fail state verified

scenario: EV charging coincides with high site demand
detection_logic: Charging active AND account demand above approved operational limit for 5 min
data_analysis: Session energy only with valid boundaries; no full-charge inference from low power
twin_relationship: Charger connected to Circuit and Vehicle Session
agent_action: Charging Agent proposes OEM schedule if supported; owner approves
outcome_measure: Charging minutes above approved account operational limit
proposed_acceptance: Reduce overlap where OEM schedule supported
limitation: No battery-full inference from low power
test_case: Unsupported API remains observe-only; protection retained

scenario: Sensor stops reporting believable data
detection_logic: Missing more than 3 publish periods OR invalid range/calibration produces Unknown
data_analysis: Completeness by required channel; missing is not zero or healthy
twin_relationship: Sensor bound to Asset by time interval
agent_action: Data Quality Agent suppresses dependent health/action/credit and requests service
outcome: Reduced false detections and unsupported actions
outcome_measure: Valid received samples / expected samples in eligible period
test_case: Disconnect AirQ; Unknown health and zero credited Mints

scenario: Internet outage interrupts dashboards
detection_logic: Offline transport queues data; duplicate idempotency key writes once
data_analysis: Event-time aggregation with lateness policy and counter epochs
agent_action: Reliability Agent shows offline status and monitors replay; expired commands dropped
outcome_measure: Stored rows per canonical idempotency key
proposed_acceptance: Exactly one row per key after replay
limitation: RP 2 h and MVP 24 h offline tests
test_case: RP 2 h / MVP 24 h outage replay, duplicate and out-of-order events

scenario: Operator requests equipment change
detection_logic: Authorize asset and bounds; reject expired/duplicate command; verify independent observed result
data_analysis: Command success requires ack plus observed outcome in timeout; otherwise unverified
twin_relationship: Asset has desired and reported State
agent_action: Action Agent executes only permitted command; local override and interlocks win
outcome_measure: Ack AND independent outcome within approved timeout
proposed_acceptance: All tested commands verified or explicitly failed
limitation: Ack alone is not physical success
test_case: Expired command, missing ack, no physical response and offline interlock tests

scenario: Device moved from showcase to partner site
detection_logic: No overlapping active binding for same channel; close old binding before move
data_analysis: Historical readings resolved using binding at measured_at
agent_action: Registry Agent queues commissioning and leaves old asset Unknown
outcome_measure: Concurrent bindings per device/channel at event time
limitation: Old space becomes Unknown on transfer
test_case: Transfer Set B; old space stops reporting current coverage

scenario: Partner attempts to view another site's data
detection_logic: Deny mismatched tenant/site scope for telemetry, twins, commands and exports
data_analysis: Denied-event trend and role review; no cross-tenant training by default
twin_relationship: Tenant owns Sites and scoped Roles
agent_action: Access Agent logs denial; privileged review assigned
outcome_measure: Successful unauthorized reads/commands/exports
test_case: Partner request for Senthil asset denied and audited

scenario: Owner requests rewards for lower consumption
detection_logic: REAL validated measurements plus approved baseline, comfort and healthy eligible assets; second verifier; unique site-period key
data_analysis: Qualified benefit ledger, separate preview and issued rewards; reversals append-only
twin_relationship: Evidence links Asset, Period, Baseline and Reward
agent_action: Evidence Agent assembles packet; verifier authorizes issuance; no actuator permission
outcome: Verified internal rewards without duplicate credit
outcome_measure: Issued quantity from verified site-period ledger
test_case: SIMULATED, INFERRED, missing comfort and duplicate period cannot be credited

scenario: Hotel partner wants repeatable hotel pilot
detection_logic: Release only with surveyed partner topology, tested devices and 7-day soak >=95% completeness
data_analysis: Site-specific outcomes; Senthil results not copied as partner actuals
twin_relationship: Partner Site contains Space, AC and Water Flow
agent_action: Commissioning Agent assembles installer checklist; Hotel partner accepts site scope
outcome: Repeatable YesTechnik pilot with measured evidence
outcome_measure: 7-day soak completeness and signed operator acceptance
limitation: Senthil data is not partner operating evidence
test_case: Tenant isolation, local operator training, rollback and partner acceptance

scenario: Channel partner reviews three working flows
detection_logic: Three REAL flows, stale handling, calibration records and controlled AC action
data_analysis: Before/action/after evidence with no promised savings percentage
twin_relationship: Site aggregates three demonstrated System Twins
agent_action: Demo Agent narrates trace IDs and evidence; operator controls action
outcome_measure: Count of accepted real AC, pump/tank and server flows
proposed_acceptance: Three real flows plus bounded AC demonstration
test_case: 25 Oct checkpoint / 30 Oct RP acceptance with recording and replay

scenario: Owner needs release and maintenance readiness
detection_logic: 14-day soak; critical energy completeness >=98%; online p95 latency <=30 s for 10 s channels; restore/isolation/rollback pass
data_analysis: Observed service KPIs by channel and period; outcome savings require valid baseline
twin_relationship: Site Twin aggregates service and asset health
agent_action: Operations Agent prepares release dossier and IVEOS tasks; Senthil releases
outcome_measure: 14-day soak plus latency, restore, isolation and rollback tests
proposed_acceptance: Critical energy >=98%; online p95 <=30 s for 10 s channels
limitation: Observed results must be filled by release owner
test_case: 9 Dec target; production restore, incident drill and named support ownership
